name: Instruments of Chaos Starring Young Indiana Jones
storyline: During the First World War, a young Indiana Jones operates as an intelligence agent for the Allies. His objective is to intercept German operatives who are traveling the globe to acquire cutting-edge weapons technology for the Kaiser's military. The trail leads him across India, Tibet, Egypt, and England, culminating in a final confrontation within Germany itself.
summary: Instruments of Chaos Starring Young Indiana Jones is an action/adventure game with platforming elements. In it you control the titular character through missions around the world.
